series_start_reason: Sanofi consolidates Genzyme from April 2011; its Q2 2011 release is the first to print a Fabrazyme line (EUR 30 million, 'Net sales since April 1st 2011' table). Genzyme-era quarters 2002Q3-2010Q4 (USD, Genzyme's own filings) are delivered under sanofi_fabrazyme_alt; Genzyme published no 2011Q1 financials (acquired April 2011), so the two cannot be joined contiguously and are in different currencies. Launch quarter not established: Genzyme's 10-K states Fabrazyme was marketed in Europe since 2001 and the US approval was April 2003.
moa: Recombinant human alpha-galactosidase A enzyme replacement therapy

approval_evidence.quote: FABRAZYME (agalsidase beta) for injection, for intravenous use Initial U.S. Approval: 2003

notes: 2011Q2-2011Q4: Genzyme franchise table, growth on constant structure basis. The Q2 2012 release prints the column header 'Q2 2011 net sales' over Q2 2012 figures (Q1 2012 47 + Q2 2012 74 = H1 2012 121).
